measures.what: outer diameter of the round board
measures.reply: led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.what: centre-to-centre spacing of the two mounting holes near the centre, and each hole's diameter
measures.reply: led disk hole diameter: 3.3 mm (each of the two small holes near the centre); led disk between holes: 30.2 mm (from the nearest edge of each hole, with calipers pulled in at the edges); led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.what: board thickness, and the height of the 4-pin input connector above the back face
measures.reply: led disk thickness: I can't measure that

measures.what: overall length, width, and thickness of the board
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; perfboard thickness: I can't measure that

measures.what: centre-to-centre spacing of the four corner holes (both directions) and each hole's diameter
measures.reply: perfboard corner holes: 2.4 mm across, and 0.9 mm from the edge of each hole to the board's edge

measures.what: height of the USB-C port's centre above the ESP32 top face, and its distance from the board end the port is on, plus the port's opening width and height
measures.reply: esp32 size: 63.17 long and 28.25 wide mm; esp32 height: it stands about 16 mm above the perfboard in its female headers; 11.05 mm of that is to the underside of its board; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge

measures.what: height of the tallest component on the top face (ESP32 top, capacitor, screw terminals) above the board top face
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; perfboard corner holes: 2.4 mm across, and 0.9 mm from the edge of each hole to the board's edge; perfboard grid: 18 x 24 holes at 2.54 mm; perfboard thickness: I can't measure that

measures.what: the widest span across the board, edge to edge, measured straight across through the centre between the two holes (the diameter)
measures.reply: led disk hole diameter: 3.3 mm (each of the two small holes near the centre); led disk between holes: 30.2 mm (from the nearest edge of each hole, with calipers pulled in at the edges); led disk hole to edge: 102.54 from the outside of one hole to the disk's edge, and 102.24 from the other hole to the other side mm; led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.what: the centre-to-edge distance from the centre point of the two holes to the disc's outer edge, measured along the line through the holes
measures.reply: led disk hole diameter: 3.3 mm (each of the two small holes near the centre); led disk hole to edge: 102.54 from the outside of one hole to the disk's edge, and 102.24 from the other hole to the other side mm; led disk hole positions: on a line through the centre, one at 3 o'clock and one at 9 o'clock, with the input wires at 12

measures.what: height of the centre of the USB-C port opening above the perfboard's top face (perfboard top to port centre, with the ESP32 plugged in)
measures.reply: esp32 height: it stands about 16 mm above the perfboard in its female headers; 11.05 mm of that is to the underside of its board; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge; esp32 usb port height: the bottom of its USB-C receptacle is 12.54 mm above the perfboard's top, and the receptacle is about 3.2 mm tall and 10.67 mm wide, its centre 3.99 mm off the ESP32's centreline

measures.item: wall screws (the two you hang the box on)
measures.what: centre-to-centre distance between the two screws in the wall, and the screw head diameter and shank diameter
measures.reply: wall screws size: #8 round-head screws in 1/4 inch anchors; I bought ones with heads 9 mm across at most; wall screws spacing: I can put them wherever you say

measures.item: wall screws (the two you hang the box on)
measures.what: how far the screw head stands off the wall once driven in (it leaves a gap under the box), and the head's thickness
measures.reply: wall screws size: #8 round-head screws in 1/4 inch anchors; I bought ones with heads 9 mm across at most; wall screws standoff: I'll leave them about 3.5 mm out from the wall

measures.what: thickness of the disc board itself, the flat edge-to-edge thickness with the LEDs (try calipers across the edge)
measures.reply: led disk hole to edge: 102.54 from the outside of one hole to the disk's edge, and 102.24 from the other hole to the other side mm; led disk diameter: I can't measure that; led disk thickness: I can't measure that
perfboard thickness: I can't measure that
